summary_en: 33.5M shares sold by Kansai Electric and subsidiary at ¥6,677/share in Kinden self-tender offer (settled June 1, 2026). Kansai Electric stake reduced from 37.13% to 24.33% of Kinden. Kansai Electric to recognize ~¥176B gain in FY3/27 standalone results; ~¥105B in consolidated results.
title_en: Results of application to Kinden's self-tender offer for its own shares
translation_en_brief: On June 1, 2026, Kansai Electric Power and subsidiary Kanden Real Estate Development completed the sale of 33.5 million shares of Kinden Corporation via Kinden's public self-tender offer at ¥6,677 per share, raising ¥223.68 billion in proceeds. The sale reduces the combined holding of Kansai Electric, Kanden Real Estate Development, and Kanden Engineering from 37.13% (73.5 million shares) to 24.33% (40.0 million shares) of Kinden. Kansai Electric anticipates recording a gain of approximately ¥176 billion in its standalone FY3/27 results and approximately ¥105 billion in consolidated results from the sale of the affiliated company shares. The company states it will continue close cooperation with Kinden in fulfilling responsibilities for safe and stable power supply and in growing together as business partners.
